notes: PATCH: sua dut diem ly do 1.45.2 van chay code cu tren Production. Root cause THAT: code JS/CSS trong 1.45.1 va 1.45.2 (evidence badge, panel close-fix, bo icon circuit) deu dung, nhung index.html van tro toi CUNG URL cu <script src="...phf-ai-engine.js?v=1.45.0_ai_read_hub"> - khong bump query string. vercel.json dat Cache-Control: public,max-age=31536000,immutable cho /assets/js/* va /assets/css/* nen trinh duyet nao da tai trang truoc do se GIU MAI ban cache cu duoi dung URL do, khong bao gio fetch lai, du build-info.json/HTML co doi. Day la dung 'version skew' ma release-gate cua repo da tung canh bao (xem scripts/phf-check-js.js RELEASE GATE) nhung gate chi kiem tra build-info.json co bump hay khong, KHONG tu dong bump ho cac query string thu cong trong index.html cho nhung script khong di qua phfAssetUrl(). Sua: bump ?v= tu 1.45.0_ai_read_hub sang 1.45.3_ai_floating_cachefix cho ca 4 tham chieu (phf-ai-engine.js, phf-ai-sandbox.js, phf-ai-floating.js, phf-ai-sandbox.css) trong index.html - URL moi buoc moi trinh duyet phai fetch lai, khong con dinh cache cu. Da doi chieu: chi index.html tham chieu 4 file nay bang script/link tag (khong co noi thu 2 nao khac, khong co service worker precache rieng - index.html co san co che tu don Service Worker cu). Da re-verify logic JS runtime (khong duplicate root/listener do co guard 'mounted', khong tu mo lai panel khi doi route hay khi phf-auth-changed voi role van la admin) - logic dung, chi la chua bao gio toi duoc trinh duyet that vi cache. Icon PHF AI chinh thuc: VAN CHUA co file trong repo - da tim toan bo assets/, khong tim thay; can luu file vao dung duong dan assets/logo/phf-ai-mark.png (hoac .svg) de thay the nhan chu 'AI' hien tai. Khong sua backend/AI tools/Evidence Gate/permission/Checklist/KNL/Training Hub/Classroom/Auth/database nao.
